description: Check a page's real Core Web Vitals: Google's Chrome UX Report field data (real users, 28-day window) plus a live Lighthouse lab run. Returns good/needs-improvement/poor ratings for LCP, INP, and CLS per Google's own published thresholds, and whether the page passes the actual ranking-signal bar. Call this before telling someone a page performs well. Pass a Pro API key as a Bearer token for 500 checks/minute; see /docs for monitoring multiple URLs with daily regression alerts.
